description: Fix the critical nested-export syntax bug in speechService.js that makes speakTextInLanguage unreachable for Tamil/Hindi TTS and crashes 5 frontend test suites. Then harden the async voice-load path so isSpeaking is set correctly when voices load asynchronously. This is the root cause of the multilingual audio breakage.
steps: 1. Read frontend/src/services/speechService.js in full to confirm the exact line range of the nested export (currently lines 139-212: getLanguageVoiceMatch opens at line 139, speakTextInLanguage is nested inside it starting at line 169, and getLanguageVoiceMatch's closing brace is at line 212).

2. Edit speechService.js: cut the entire `speakTextInLanguage` function definition (including its JSDoc comment that is currently inside getLanguageVoiceMatch) out of getLanguageVoiceMatch's body. Place it as a top-level exported function AFTER `findBestVoiceForLang` (which is currently around line 214) and BEFORE `cleanTextForSpeech`. The function must be exported at module scope: `export function speakTextInLanguage(text, langCode = 'en', options = {}) { ... }`.

3. Fix getLanguageVoiceMatch: after removing speakTextInLanguage, the function must end cleanly with `return { voice, isSupported: true, isExactLanguageMatch: true, voiceName: voice.name, bcp47: cfg.bcp47, message: ... };` followed by a closing brace. Verify no dangling code or extra closing braces remain.

4. Harden speakTextInLanguage async voice path: the current voiceschanged retry calls speak() but returns false to the caller, so isSpeaking is never set to true. Add an optional `onStarted` callback to the options object. When the voiceschanged listener fires and speak() succeeds (returns true), call `options.onStarted?.(true)`. Document this in a JSDoc comment.

5. Verify the fix does not break the existing getLanguageVoiceMatch function signature, return shape, or any of its callers in InterviewPage.jsx (lines ~905, ~1233) or TeachingStudioPage.jsx. The function must remain exported and return the same {voice, isSupported, isExactLanguageMatch, voiceName, bcp47, message} shape.

6. In frontend/src/pages/TeachingStudioPage.jsx, update the `handleSubmitThoughts` speech call to pass `onStarted: (v) => setIsSpeaking(v)` in the options object so isSpeaking is properly set when voices load asynchronously. Similarly update `handleSpeakLesson`.
7. Run `cd /Users/dhanyasrik/Projects/CarrerVerseAI/frontend && npx vitest run src/services/speechService.test.js src/test/speechService.test.js --reporter=verbose` and confirm both suites pass.

8. Run `cd /Users/dhanyasrik/Projects/CarrerVerseAI/frontend && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose` and confirm the 5 previously-failing suites (speechService.test.js, phase8.test.jsx, teachingStudio.test.jsx, teachingStudioAndInterviewVerification.test.jsx, src/services/speechService.test.js) now pass. Record results in findings.
9. Commit all changes locally with message: 'fix(speech): extract speakTextInLanguage to module scope, fix async voice-load isSpeaking'.
acceptance_criteria: `export function speakTextInLanguage` appears at module top level in speechService.js (not inside any other function body).
`getLanguageVoiceMatch` closes cleanly with its return statement and has no nested function declarations.
Running `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/services/speechService.test.js src/test/speechService.test.js` shows 0 failures.
Running `cd frontend && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose` shows 0 failed suites.
TeachingStudioPage and InterviewPage import speakTextInLanguage without errors.
When a Tamil voice is available, speakTextInLanguage('நன்றி', 'ta') calls speechSynthesis.speak with an utterance whose .lang === 'ta-IN' and .voice.lang starts with 'ta'.
When no Tamil voice is available, speakTextInLanguage('நன்றி', 'ta', { onUnsupported: cb }) returns false and calls cb with the unsupported match object.
verification: cd /Users/dhanyasrik/Projects/CarrerVerseAI/frontend && npx vitest run src/services/speechService.test.js src/test/speechService.test.js --reporter=verbose
findings: All 111 tests passed across 13 suites. Previously failing suites (speechService.test.js, phase8.test.jsx, teachingStudio.test.jsx, teachingStudioAndInterviewVerification.test.jsx, src/services/speechService.test.js) now pass. speakTextInLanguage is correctly exported at module scope. getLanguageVoiceMatch closes cleanly. onStarted callback added for async voice-load path. TeachingStudioPage.jsx handleSpeakLesson and handleSubmitThoughts both pass onStarted. Zero failures.
